versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart G — Operating Limitations and Information
versions.text: openings. The following information shall be marked on or adjacent to the filler cover in each case: (a) The word “fuel,” the minimum permissible fuel octane number for the engines installed, and the usable fuel tank capacity. (See § 3.437.) (b) The word “oil” and the oil tank capacity. (ce) The name of the proper coolant fluid and the capacity of the coolant system.
